q: In 2 Thessalonians, Paul says the Lord is faithful and will guard you from whom?
quote: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.

q: In 2 Thessalonians, what did Paul say about anyone unwilling to work?
quote: If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.

q: In 2 Thessalonians, Paul tells the brothers not to grow weary in what?
quote: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.

q: In 2 Thessalonians, what false claim alarmed the believers?
a: The Day of the Lord had come
why: Paul told them not to be shaken.
quote: alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.

q: In 2 Thessalonians, how did Paul mark his letters as truly his?
a: A greeting in his own hand
why: It was his mark in every letter.
quote: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter

q: Who sent 2 Thessalonians together with Paul and Timothy?
quote: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians
